laws.rule: Catalonia charges a tax on stays in tourist establishments (IEET) per person per night, for up to 7 nights at the same place; under-17s are exempt. Outside Barcelona city, from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027: EUR 4.50 at five-star, grand luxury hotels and luxury campsites (about A$7.15), EUR 1.80 at four-star and four-star-superior hotels (A$2.86), EUR 1.75 in tourist-use homes (holiday rentals, A$2.78), EUR 0.90 at other campsites and establishments (A$1.43), and EUR 0.80 at youth hostels (A$1.27). From 1 April 2027 these rise to EUR 6.00, 2.40, 2.50, 1.20 and 1.00 (about A$9.53, A$3.81, A$3.97, A$1.91 and A$1.59). AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293.
laws.heading: Agència Tributària de Catalunya, IEET tariffs (Llei 2/2026)

laws.rule: Barcelona city has its own, higher regional tariff band: from 1 April 2026, EUR 7.00 at five-star and grand luxury hotels (about A$11.12), EUR 3.40 at four-star hotels (A$5.40), EUR 4.50 in tourist-use homes (A$7.15), EUR 2.00 at other campsites and establishments (A$3.18) and EUR 1.00 at youth hostels (A$1.59). Cruise passengers pay per person too: outside Barcelona EUR 3.00 for calls over 12 hours and EUR 4.50 for 12 hours or less; in Barcelona EUR 4.00 and EUR 6.00.
laws.heading: Agència Tributària de Catalunya, IEET tariffs (Llei 2/2026)

laws.rule: Councils can add a municipal surcharge on top of the regional tax by local ordinance: outside Barcelona up to EUR 4 per night, and never more than the regional tariff. Barcelona has charged its own surcharge since 2021, and several councils near Barcelona started on 1 October 2026; the Agència Tributària de Catalunya lists which councils charge one and how much.
